# Contributing

[Italiano](CONTRIBUTING.it.md)

Read README.md and architecture, development and compatibility guides under docs/en. Run the relevant builds and tests before proposing changes. Keep normal input native, remote sharing opt-in and secrets out of logs. Report commit, devices/OS, cable, steps and expected/actual behavior. Compilation is not device acceptance. New headsets require specific drivers and testing. Preserve component notices in NOTICE.md.
